learning_outcomes.text: Extend the knowledge in the wide area of metrology.

syllabus_topics: Design of the CMM Cartesian coordinate system arranged
Design of the CMM Non-cartesian coordinate system arranged
Application of CMM in the industry with a touch sensor system
Application of CMM in the industry with an optical sensor system
Optical systems for evaluation of surface profile
Configuring the CMM, probing system and the individual sensors
Definition of basic geometric elements and measured characteristics
Strategies of measurement for individual elements
Advanced measurement parameters depending on the requirements of measurement
Protocol, graphical representation of measured characteristics of the CAD model
Data Processing - capability evaluation of process Cp, Cpk and gauge Cg, Cgk
Measurement System Analysis - GR & R method
bibliography: Metrology in Industry: The Key for Quality (ISTE) by French College of Metrology
Coordinate Metrology and CAx - Application in Industrial Production, Basics, Interfaces and Integration by Tilo Pfeifer, Dietrich Imkamp and Robert Schmitt
Coordinate Measuring Machines and Systems (Manufacturing Engineering and Materials Processing) by John A. Bosch (Hardcover - Apr 10, 1995)
